A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same QAEdit and model-editing evaluation study. The main text, figures, tables and Appendix A.1-A.9 support reliable comparison despite layout changes and table renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original single-edit, controlled-module and sequential-edit experiments in Sections 5-7, with additional empirical results in Appendix A.5-A.9.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and their outcomes, including the benchmark comparison in Table 3 and sequential-editing results in Table 9 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The editing procedures and four-module evaluation framework are unchanged. Neither the main text nor Appendix A.4 introduces a revised algorithm, model component, objective or inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate QAEdit, constructed from Natural Questions, TriviaQA and SimpleQA, alongside ZsRE and COUNTERFACT. The single-edit, context-guided and sequential-editing scenarios are retained without coverage changes.

E2.justification: The evaluated methods remain FT-M, MEND, ROME implemented as R-ROME, MEMIT, GRACE and WISE. Their experiment-specific subsets and the exclusion of MEND from the main Llama-3-8b comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the same three LLMs, evaluation subsets, greedy decoding and metrics. The 3,000-instance controlled study, 1,000-edit sequential protocol and batch-size settings also match.

E4.justification: The four controlled module studies, output-error examples, batch-size analysis and tracking of previously edited knowledge are retained. Appendix A.9 reports the same MEND batch-size analysis.

E5.justification: Both report point estimates without seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results, plotted trends and example outputs are unchanged. Table 1 retains 0.385 average accuracy; sequential QAEdit results match after v1 Table 8 becomes v4 Table 9. Appendix Tables 11-14 also retain their results.

T1.justification: No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised. The existing loss and norm-constraint descriptions in Appendix A.4.1 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: realistic QA evaluation exposes inflated editing scores and severe sequential-editing limitations. The added subtitle restates the existing critique without changing its scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning teacher forcing, truncation, method-specific failures and sequential interference are unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning representative method/model coverage, solution development and exclusion of in-context editing.

D1.justification: v4 adds a first-page footnote stating that the authors' code and data are released and providing their repository link, absent from v1. Existing implementation descriptions, hardware information and appendix prompt templates are unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference lists and substantive related-work discussion match. Positioning relative to prior editing evaluations, side-effect studies and AKEW is unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds a subtitle, an introductory quotation and acknowledgments, and updates affiliation text. The scientific prose and section sequence are otherwise essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adjusts spacing and relocates several displays, including exchanging the order and numbering of Tables 8 and 9. Table 3's caption now specifies relative performance drop. The figures and table contents are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 adds explicit code/data access information and clarifies the meaning of Table 3's shading, providing modest gains in reproducibility information and presentation. The scientific evidence, conclusions and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
